[PREFERENCE] User is curious about steam inhalation as a method to relieve sinus pressure.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant provided tips for relieving sinus pressure, including staying hydrated, using saline nasal sprays, steam inhalation, using a humidifier, applying warm compresses, elevating the head while sleeping, using nasal strips, exercising regularly, considering over-the-counter medications, and consulting a healthcare professional.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant elaborated on how to perform steam inhalation correctly and recommended doing it 2-3 times a day for sinus pressure and congestion.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant recommended specific brands/types of nasal sprays, including Simply Saline, Ocean, Arm & Hammer Simply Saline for saline sprays, Flonase and Nasacort for steroid sprays, and Afrin for decongestant sprays.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant provided tips for using nasal sprays, including using them correctly, regularly, and not overusing decongestant sprays.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant explained the benefits of saline nasal sprays and ingredients to look for or avoid, emphasizing that they are suitable for daily use.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in trying a saline nasal spray to help with congestion.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant suggested that the user monitor their symptoms and consult with a healthcare provider if their symptoms persist or worsen.
